artifacts.notes: The 108,391,684-byte ZIP exceeds the 100 MiB per-file Git limit and is therefore not tracked. Four faithful PNG derivatives retain the title, colophon and exact Ritus/Ordo comparison loci for offline inspection. The other scan positions require the public archive; its current availability is not guaranteed by the recorded hash. Scan positions are photographed openings, not 339 printed pages.
